Arcs.Objective: Adrian Vale must transform from a discarded, powerless maintenance worker into the leader of a cohesive, powerful unit of outcasts, ultimately exposing the truth that summoned heroes are sacrifices and breaking the cycle of exploitation in Avarra.
Arcs.ResolutionCriteria: Adrian and his bonded companions have defeated the immediate threats posed by the kingdom's rival heroes and the monsters of the frontier; the true nature of the summoning ritual (feeding an ancient power) is publicly revealed or irrefutably proven; Adrian has established a stable, voluntary bond network that functions as a strategic asset, proving that trust-based power surpasses domination-based power.
Arcs.CurrentPhase: The story has not begun; no events described by the premise have occurred.
Arcs.NextMilestone: Adrian is summoned to the magical world of Avarra and undergoes the class determination ritual, where he is branded with the lowest-ranked class, Wayfarer, and granted the ability Concord.

Arcs.Objective: Adrian must survive the kingdom's rejection and the hostile frontier environment by forming his first voluntary bonds with outcast individuals, establishing the foundational mechanics of Concord and securing his immediate survival.
Arcs.ResolutionCriteria: Adrian has formed stable, voluntary bonds with at least two of the designated outcast companions (the disgraced knight, elven sorceress, beastkin scout, or priestess); he has survived the initial monster attacks on the frontier; the kingdom has officially stripped him of support and declared him a failed hero; the bonded companions have begun to share fragments of their talents with Adrian, demonstrating the hidden strength of Concord.
Arcs.CurrentPhase: The story has not begun; no events described by the premise have occurred.
Arcs.NextMilestone: Adrian is summoned to the magical world of Avarra and undergoes the class determination ritual, where he is branded with the lowest-ranked class, Wayfarer, and granted the ability Concord.

Arcs.Objective: Adrian must integrate the remaining outcast companions into his group, navigating their individual traumas and distrust to build a cohesive unit capable of challenging stronger enemies and exploring forgotten dungeons.
Arcs.ResolutionCriteria: All four designated outcast companions are actively bonded to Adrian and each other; the group has successfully conquered at least one forgotten dungeon or defeated a major monster threat; the internal dynamics of the group have stabilized, with trust replacing initial suspicion; the group has developed a distinct identity as a force capable of challenging the status quo.
Arcs.CurrentPhase: Adrian has survived the initial frontier dangers and formed bonds with at least two companions. The group is fragile, with unresolved tensions between members and limited understanding of Concord's full potential. They are operating on the fringes of society, lacking resources and a clear long-term strategy.
Arcs.NextMilestone: The group encounters a significant threat (a rival hero or a powerful monster) that forces them to rely on their combined bonded abilities, leading to a pivotal victory that cements their unity and reveals the first clues about the true nature of the summoning ritual.

Arcs.Objective: Adrian must uncover and expose the conspiracy behind the summoning ritual, confronting the ancient power beneath the kingdoms and the rival heroes sent to silence them, ultimately breaking the cycle of exploitation.
Arcs.ResolutionCriteria: The truth about the summoning ritual (that heroes are fed to an ancient power) is revealed to the public or the relevant authorities; the rival heroes sent to silence the group are defeated or neutralized; Adrian and his companions have successfully challenged the source of the ancient power, breaking the cycle; Adrian has proven that freely given trust is the greatest power, achieving a new status as a true hero not by prophecy, but by unity.
Arcs.CurrentPhase: The group is a cohesive force with a growing reputation. They have gathered evidence of the kingdom's corruption and the true purpose of the summoning. They are facing increasing pressure from rival heroes and the kingdom's military, but they possess the knowledge and power to challenge the system.
Arcs.NextMilestone: Adrian and his companions confront the leader of the rival heroes or the high priest of the Church, forcing a public revelation of the summoning ritual's true purpose, which triggers the final conflict against the ancient power.
